headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Total consolidated GAAP revenue from Bitcoin mining operations.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Consolidated GAAP Revenue ($M): CleanSpark generated $138.01M in Q3 FY26 (-30.5% YoY vs $198.64M; $223.65M in Q4 FY25). Street Q4 FY26E consensus sits at $127.75M (-42.9% YoY, range $110.65M–$158.07M), while buy-side whisper looks for $132.0M+ on 1,708 BTC mined.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: GAAP diluted earnings per share including BTC fair-value remeasurement and D&A.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: GAAP Diluted EPS ($/sh): Consensus models -$0.37/sh for Q4 FY26E vs -$0.39 actual in Q3 FY26 (16.3% miss vs -$0.33 est) and +$0.16 in Q4 FY25. Whisper targets -$0.30/sh or better if quarter-end BTC mark-to-market remeasurement is favorable.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Total self-mined Bitcoin produced during the fiscal quarter.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Quarterly Bitcoin Mined: CleanSpark already pre-announced monthly unaudited production totaling 1,708 BTC for Jul–Sep 2026 (586 Jul + 593 Aug + 529 Sep), down from ~1,800+ BTC in Q3 FY26 due to higher network difficulty and curtailment.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Average energized mining computing capacity across CleanSpark facilities.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Operating Hashrate: Peak energized capacity sits at 50.0 EH/s, while average operating hashrate averaged ~37.6 EH/s across Q4 FY26 (38.6 Jul, 38.3 Aug, 36.0 Sep) reflecting strategic power curtailment and miner redeployment.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Contracted hyperscale data center critical IT load and total grid-connected power portfolio.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: AI/HPC Infrastructure: Sandersville 175 MW NNN lease with Meta Platforms ($6.6B initial 20-yr contracted revenue, $2.276B project notes closed Sep 2026) plus Meta LOI/exclusivity on up to 885 MW in Texas out of a 1.8+ GW total power portfolio.
